title: Vintage Playboy Magazine July 1965 Girls Of The Riviera Complete With Centerfold
descriptionText:
Dive into a piece of history with the Vintage Playboy Magazine from July 1965, featuring the captivating 'Girls of the Riviera'. This edition is a treasure for collectors and enthusiasts alike, offering a glimpse into the past through its nostalgic articles, art, and photography.

Complete with the original centerfold, this magazine showcases the unique artistry and photography that defined an era. Published by American Media Inc, it is a must-have for those who appreciate the blend of mens' interests, art, photography, and historical significance.
